title: Concept: Nagios Core console is reachable without authentication
description: A monitoring console is a map of the estate: host names, service names, check commands and the current state of each. It also shows which checks are failing, which is where an attacker would start.
applicability: Responses that serve a monitoring interface from a host reachable by ordinary users.
risk: The caller maps the internal hosts and services and sees which of them are degraded.
